messages:
Maya: Cutting RC candidate from main at commit 9a7b3f4 for inference runtime changes. Requesting sign-off & pin for today’s 18:00 UTC window.
Sam: Got it. Is there a DB migration? Any config flags?
Maya: No DB migration. There's a feature flag `enable_kv_prefetch` toggled on canary for 10%.
Priya: Release notes draft -> https://docs.internal/release-notes/9a7b3f4
Nate: Can we confirm model-serving image tag? `inference-runtime:2026-04-rc1`
Maya: Yes that's the tag. Also we need KV warm preheat in staging for 30m before promo.
Sam: Ops checklist: smoke tests, kv warm, canary at 5/20/100% traffic windows, rollback playbook ready.
deploy-bot: /create-rc rc-9a7b3f4 --image inference-runtime:2026-04-rc1 --pin
deploy-bot: RC created: rc-2026-04-9a7b3f4 (thread pinned)
Priya: QA: running sample convo evals now. Uploading failures to the eval dashboard.
Priya: No major regressions so far, minor tokenization diff in non-English tests.
Maya: Decision: proceed with canary at 5% after KV warm. If latency > 150ms p50 or error rate > 0.5% abort.
Nate: Noted. I'll be on-call during the window. Sheriff: @Ops Sheriff can you ack and be ready to flip stage flag?
Ops Sheriff: ACK. I'll be watching metrics and ready to cut traffic back to stable.
Sam: Release notes finalised and linked in the RC: https://docs.internal/release-notes/rc-2026-04-9a7b3f4
Maya: Starting KV preheat in staging: `kubectl run kv-warm --image=kv-warm:latest --env MODE=preheat` (30m)
deploy-bot: /promote rc-2026-04-9a7b3f4 --to prod --stage canary-5
deploy-bot: Promotion started: canary 5%: rolling out to 3 pods
deploy-bot: Health checks: passing
Maya: Observability: watch per-route latency and token-cost on console. I'll watch streaming routes.
Priya: QA: short regressions tracking: create ticket RN-334, will attach diffs.
Nate: Canary metrics look stable at 5% for 15m. p50 120ms, error 0.12%.
Maya: Move to 20% in 10m if no new signals.
deploy-bot: /promote rc-2026-04-9a7b3f4 --advance canary-20
deploy-bot: Advanced to 20%: 10 pods now
Ops Sheriff: Noticed a spike in tail latency on region eu-west-1 at minute 6 of 20% -> digging
Nate: Rolling back EU zone only to stable while we investigate.
deploy-bot: /rollback rc-2026-04-9a7b3f4 --zones eu-west-1
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for eu-west-1: traffic shifted back to stable
Maya: Good catch. Priya, can we reproduce with the QA trace?
Priya: Captured trace, sending to eng-runtime.
Sam: After root cause patch, we'll re-originate candidate with a hotfix commit and re-run canary.
Maya: For record: pin `inference-runtime:2026-04-rc1` to this RC until hotfix merged. If hotfix merges before midnight we'll re-cut.
Ops Sheriff: Logging incident note in postmortems channel.
Maya: End of thread. Thanks team.
